messages:
ashley (support): fyi — Acme flagged a month-end mismatch. Dashboard shows 12,345 tokens for Feb but invoice lists 18,500. Customer attached CSV and wants a breakdown. Can we triage quickly?

jia (billing): thanks — can you paste the account + invoice id and dashboard snapshot time? any obvious delta in lineitems? :mag:

ashley (support): acct_9X, invoice INV-20260228-ACME, dashboard snapshot 2026-02-28T23:59:59Z. CSV link: https://files.internal/acme-feb-csv (sent privately). Customer suspects slabline rounding or double-count.

billing-bot: invoice-generator: INV-20260228-ACME -> generation started @ 2026-03-01T00:05:12Z, backfill job usage-backfill finished @ 2026-03-01T01:12:04Z 

jia (billing): quick look at invoice rows: embeddings slab shows a +6,200 token spike binned into invoice line 'background-embeds'. Dashboard counters (streaming) don't show that. Running raw events query now.

omar (eng): could be a retry/backfill dup. Our dedupe on dashboard counts uses event_id; invoice aggregator counts raw ingestion rows. If backfill produced rows with NULL event_id they would inflate invoice totals. Can you run a filter for NULL event_id + source? Example query:

```sql
SELECT source, count(*) as hits, sum(tokens) as tokens
FROM usage_events
WHERE account_id = 'acct_9X'
  AND ts >= '2026-02-28T23:55:00Z'
  AND ts <= '2026-03-01T00:05:00Z'
  AND event_id IS NULL
GROUP BY source;
```

jia (billing): ran similar query — result: source 'embed-worker/retry' has hits=310, tokens=6200 between 23:57 and 23:59 with event_id NULL. Dashboard pipeline dropped duplicates because it dedupes by event_id, but invoice aggregator counted raw rows. That explains ~6.2k token delta.

ashley (support): so root cause = backfill+retry producing rows missing event_id → invoice counted them, dashboard did not. Customer asking for credit and fix steps.

jia (billing): proposed remediation: 1) issue credit for duplicated tokens (6200 tokens ≈ $18.60) — I've applied a credit to INV-20260228-ACME for the difference and flagged finance. 2) engineering patch to ensure backfills include event_id or set a "backfill_marker" tag that invoice-agg ignores for first 24h.

omar (eng): agree. Plan: open INF-4521 to add event_id to backfill generator and add an invoice-agg guard to ignore rows with backfill_marker=true during the first reconciliation cycle. Also add an alert that compares invoice_vs_dashboard_ratio at cutoff > 1.05. ETA: patch in 24h, rollout after tests.

ashley (support): updated customer — credited $18.60, engineering working on a fix, they accepted. Leaving open until INF-4521 is merged and SRE confirms. :white_check_mark:

jia (billing): finance notified and credit visible on customer portal. I'll follow up in the invoice thread and close once INF-4521 is deployed.

omar (eng): created INF-4521 and linked to this thread. Added unit tests for backfill generator. Will post PR and notify.

ashley (support): thanks all — great cross-team response. Closing the customer escalation once SRE confirms no further duplicates in next cutoff.
